items.problem: CS0118 'namespace but is used like a type' — the WinUI project's RootNamespace shadows the WinRT type the sample demonstrates (also leaves a scaffold-vs-source namespace split).
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 65 'error CS0118'; turn 15 'dotnet new winui -n ActivitySensor'; source declares 'namespace SDKTemplate'; grep of the migration skill returns no RootNamespace/CS0118 guidance.
items.root_cause: The skill's Step 2 gives no rule for RootNamespace, so the agent keeps the scaffold's project-name namespace, which equals the demonstrated WinRT type (systemic for API-named SDK samples).
items.change: Add a '<RootNamespace> — match the source' subsection to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#csproj (with a detect-the-source-namespace snippet), a 'CS0118' entry to the 'Common build errors' section, and a one-line rule in SKILL.md Step 2 pointing to it.
items.expected_effect: The agent sets RootNamespace to the source namespace (SDKTemplate) during Step 2, so the app compiles first time with no namespace collision or split; if CS0118 still appears the build-errors section names the exact fix.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of any API-named SDK sample (ActivitySensor/Barometer/Compass/…), the first build produces zero CS0118 'namespace but is used like a type' errors and the .csproj RootNamespace equals the source's namespace.

items.problem: WMC0141 'Style BasedOn property must be a Style, not ThemeResourceExtension' — Style.BasedOn was migrated to {ThemeResource}.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 65 'App.xaml(14,14): WMC0141'; source SharedContent/Styles.xaml uses BasedOn="{StaticResource BodyTextBlockStyle}" (9 styles); MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md line 549 told the agent to migrate 'brushes / styles' to {ThemeResource}.
items.root_cause: The ThemeResource guidance over-generalized to 'styles', so BasedOn (a compile-time reference that must be StaticResource) got rewritten to a deferred ThemeResource lookup, which is illegal.
items.change: Narrow the ThemeResource section to brush/value setters and add an explicit warning that Style.BasedOn must stay {StaticResource}, with the WMC0141 error text and the shared Styles.xaml example.
items.expected_effect: The agent leaves BasedOn as {StaticResource} and only converts brush/value setters to {ThemeResource}, avoiding WMC0141.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run, App.xaml/Styles.xaml compile with zero WMC0141 errors and every Style.BasedOn still uses {StaticResource}.

deferred_to_human: Tier-0 harness: the starter template command 'dotnet new winui -n {app_name}' names the project after the sample (== the demonstrated WinRT type). Consider passing a neutral project name (or the source namespace) so RootNamespace never collides — the skill now works around this, but the harness could remove the hazard at the source.
